answers.core: It can be a plugin – https://github.com/Herbherth/GDScript-Quality-of-Life already is – but I don't see why this can't be part of the editor as every GDscript coder will experience this minor inconvenience often in their project.
answers.workaround: You can hammer the delete key a few more times, hopefully not also accidentally deleting the characters you're trying to bring to the current line 😅
